The '''Recorder of Assignments and Transactions for the Supervisor&#39;s Committee''', nicknamed '''Chuckles''' by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], was a [[TT-40 librarian droid]] serving as a records keeper in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Griann]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Teyr/Legends|Teyr]]. Skywalker and his companion, [[Akanah Norand Goss Pell]], consulted the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] for census information in their search for the [[Fallanassi/Legends|Fallanassi]] sect.<ref name="SoL">''[[Shield of Lies]]''</ref>
